# PR #2336: Patch: drop the "Provisional statistics" banner and the "How to read these statistics" notes from /stats

Closes #2325

## What changed and why

`/stats` no longer renders the "Provisional statistics" banner (with its "View previous patch (…) →" fallback button) or the "How to read these statistics" accordion. They took up space and told the player nothing useful; the patch bar's previous/next buttons and picker (R1973002) are the way back to the previous patch. Presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): the server, the wire and `GET /api/stats/cards` are untouched — the response still sends `source`, `sourceLabel` and `gate`, and the client just stops reading `source`.

- `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx`: deleted the banner JSX, the accordion JSX, `withNodes` + docstring, `isProvisional`, `fallback`, and the `Fragment` import; header comment now cites R2325000. Kept `previousPatchOf` (Sets tab still calls it twice) and `minSample` (sorting, cells, `CreatedPanel`, Sets explainer still read it).
- `apps/web/src/routes/stats.css`: deleted the 8 `.stats-provisional-*`/`.stats-info-*` rules; Games-panel comment reworded.
- `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: deleted exactly the 14 keys only the removed blocks used (verified no remaining `t()` reads them; plain `not enough games`/`not enough data`, `Patches`, `When drawn`, `Play rate`, `Radiant`, `Normal` stay).
- `apps/web/src/stats/testids.ts`, `e2e/support/testids.ts`: deleted `provisionalBanner`/`fallbackToggle` and `STATS_PROVISIONAL_BANNER`/`STATS_FALLBACK_TOGGLE`.
- `apps/web/src/routes/stats.test.tsx`: rewrote the R654 and R661 tests as `R2325000 R654…` / `R2325000 R661…` absence tests (both keep the old R-token so each ruling keeps a named proof in this file); deleted the 4 fallback/banner tests (the patch-bar test at old line 1577 already covers the previous button, so the R1973002 banner test was dropped, not rewritten); trimmed only the explainer assertion from the `not enough data` test.
- `e2e/cypress/e2e/34-stats.cy.ts` + `BUILD.md` row: renamed test to `R2325000 R654 R661…`, asserts banner selector absent and neither heading on screen.
- Rulings: new `spec/rulings/R2325000.md` (`proven_in` lists both test files); R654/R661/R1973002 titles carry `(amended by R2325000)`, `cards` extended, one-line amendment appended; `spec/pending/2325.md` holds the §11 paragraph. Never touched `spec/11-rulings.md` / `INDEX.md`, never ran `spec index`.

- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` → exit 0 (needed `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` first; the initial errors were only the unbuilt `wasm/pkg`, a pre-existing tree state).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/stats.test.tsx` → 52 passed, 0 failed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` → 6 passed.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` → exit 0.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` → `1472 rulings, 3330 proofs, 45908 citations in 2935 files, 17880 links: ok`.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` → `classify: Internal` (no card-data change, no patches fragment).
- `34-stats.cy.ts` against `build:e2e` + `vite preview` with stubbed `/api/stats/*` → 1 passing, 0 failing.
- `cargo fmt --check` → clean; `git status` shows only the 11 edited files + 2 new ruling/pending files.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- The e2e machine had no Cypress binary (`CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY=0` in env), no Xvfb and no sudo. Approved on round 1 of 3.
